title: VoiceLoop trainer contract v1
description: Specifies train(dataset_manifest, config) -> {artifact_uri, metrics, run_id}. A payload is either the call input (contract_part = input) or the call output (contract_part = output), distinguished by the contract_part discriminator. Implemented once by the plugin base class in P2-06 and reused by every trainer plugin.

schema_version.description: Exact version of this contract; bump on any breaking or additive contract change.

contract_part.description: Discriminator selecting the TrainRequest branch of this schema.

dataset_manifest.description: A dataset manifest as defined by dataset_manifest.schema.json; at minimum it must carry content_hash so the run is traceable to its data. Extra manifest fields are allowed and encouraged.

content_hash.description: Deterministic hash of the dataset contents (sha256 hex recommended). Logged to MLflow as lineage.

dataset_id.description: Stable identifier of the versioned dataset.

config.description: Trainer/settings configuration. Model choice must come from typed settings rather than a hard-coded name; trainer-specific parameters belong under params.

trainer.description: Registered trainer plugin name, e.g. whisper-lora, nemo, parser-lora.

model.description: Base model identifier resolved from settings, not hard-coded in code.

params.description: Trainer-specific hyperparameters (learning rate, epochs, LoRA scaling, decoding settings).

TrainResponse.title: Trainer output
TrainResponse.description: Result returned by train(...). artifact_uri must point at the deployable artifact (merged adapter or converted model), not a raw training checkpoint, so evaluation can run on what will serve (context.md section 2 invariant 3).

schema_version.description: Exact version of this contract; bump on any breaking or additive contract change.

contract_part.description: Discriminator selecting the TrainResponse branch of this schema.

artifact_uri.description: URI of the converted/mergeable deployable artifact in the object store or registry.

metrics.description: Numeric training-time metrics keyed by name (for example train_loss, val_wer). Promotion metrics come from the eval report, not from here.

run_id.description: MLflow run identifier for this training job.

lineage.description: Provenance required by context.md section 2 invariant 9. Optional at the type level so early adapters can adopt incrementally, but all three fields are required whenever lineage is present; production jobs must emit it.

dataset_hash.description: content_hash of the dataset_manifest passed to train.

git_sha.description: Git commit SHA of the training code.

image_digest.description: Digest of the pinned training container image.
